items.title: A monomorphism of algebraic spaces over a field is either empty or the spectrum of the field

items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if Z -> Spec(k) is a monomorphism of algebraic spaces over a field k, then Z is either empty or isomorphic to Spec(k) (source lines 1998-2003). The proof first shows Z is separated, hence has an open dense subspace Z' which is a scheme, then applies the scheme statement that a monomorphism towards the spectrum of a field is either empty or an isomorphism: in the empty case Z is empty, and in the isomorphism case the monomorphism property forces Z' = Z = Spec(k).
